verdict.rationale: Delaware's own pages show several transactions can be done online. Name reservation is online, and annual reports and franchise taxes must be filed and paid online through a keyless portal. Formation itself has no transactional portal, though: entity forms are fillable PDFs submitted by upload through the Document Filing service, by fax or by mail, and certificates come back by First Class mail unless a courier account number is provided. Missing for 10: a native end-to-end online formation flow, online confirmation and delivery of formation documents, and hands-on corroboration that the online flows complete.
